70:13: request bodies of type application/xml are not decoded from their schema yet and are answered with 415
305:21: the value of part header "X-Checksum" is not checked yet, only its presence
408:13: multipart bodies must be objects of primitive values or arrays of them; multipart/form-data is answered with 415
406:9: request bodies of type multipart/form-data are not supported yet; the operation is answered with 501 Not Implemented
